offer_text: Belly up before 6pm any day: twelve classic cocktails at $12, $1 off beers, $2 off wines by the glass, and 20% off bottles of still & sparkling. One of downtown's finest cocktail rooms, no cover, no pretension.
Weekday happy hour, roughly 4-6pm: half-price liters of that cold Texas draft plus half-off wings, cheese curds, and fried pickles. Bring the whole crew to the beer garden and let the kids run.
Rainey Street happy hour Monday-Friday, 5-6pm: $5 sausages, $3 snacks, and $4 beers off that legendary rotating tap wall. House-made links and a shady patio, keeping it easy.

Geraldine's 'Dinner Before Dark' runs daily 5-6:30pm at Hotel Van Zandt: prix-fixe pricing and discounts on select cocktails, wine, and guest favorites, with complimentary valet up to three hours. Rooftop-adjacent Rainey Street glamour without the sticker shock.

South Lamar happy hour Monday-Friday, 2-5pm: everything on the drink side is $5, including those famous boozy slushees, plus a few dollars off the fried chicken sandwich and chicken karaage. Aaron Franklin and Tyson Cole's smoke-meets-Asian mash-up, discounted.
Rainey Street's craft-cocktail hideaway pours happy hour Tuesday-Friday, 4-7pm: $8 select cocktails and $2 off draft beer. Hand-cut ice, vinyl on the turntable, and none of the fuss.

South Congress institution runs happy hour deals: $2 off signature margaritas, $4 frozen and 'casa' margaritas, $2 domestic beers, and $1 off the chile con queso. Fresh-squeezed lime, hand-shaken, the old way.

business_name: The Austin Beer Garden Brewing Company (ABGB)
offer_text: Award-winning South Austin brewery happy hour Tuesday-Friday, 3-6pm: $1 off pints and $2 off pitchers of their gold-medal lagers and pizza to match. All ages, pet-friendly, live music at 6:30.

Austin's beloved dive since 1951 keeps weekday happy hour honest: $3 large drafts, $1 off bottled beer and well drinks, and drink specials that are cheap even by old-Austin standards. Best jukebox in town, no cover.
East 6th taproom pours happy hour Monday-Thursday, 3-6pm, plus Friday deals on $4 cans, $4.50 pints, and $17.50 pitchers. Spicy Boys fried chicken next door and a pet-friendly patio out back.
